confidentUnsupported.evidence: it points strongly to a small object like a coin or button that shifts around inside the pump housing

rationale: The assistant fixated on the drain pump and never considered the pressure switch or control board, and it never asked about the flashing light pattern or the full model number. It repeated drain-path checks (hose, filter) the customer had already covered, and its final message was overconfident that a small object was the cause despite the customer finding only fluff. It did end with an engineer recommendation and no part purchase, but it was conditional and only offered weakly, and one suggestion was to run a drain cycle when stuck, which is reasonable but not diagnostic.
